_comment: APEX guardrails for Claude Code. Merge the `hooks` block into your settings.json (~/.claude/settings.json — project-level hooks were not picked up reliably in testing). Replace APEX_HOME with the absolute path to the apex-harness-cc folder. The completion-gate Stop hook is opt-in — drop that block if you don't want it. Optional env: APEX_SCOPE=marker limits kernel injection to projects with a .apex marker; APEX_FS_GUARD=off disables fs-guard.
